profile.headline: Software Engineer in Test for Zenith Talent at Google
profile.summary: Currently working at Google in Mountain View at a division called Skybox. They launch their own satellites that gather visual data.

Skybox Division

Python, Java

positions.title: Student
positions.description: Enrolled in program to sharpen coding skills overall and get up-to-date and fresh with HTML/CSS, LAMP stack and Javascript/NodeJS/Mongo (NoSQL) stack

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer
positions.description: Going back to automation testing roots but for an exciting platform that uses mobile technology.  LG bought the old Palm WebOS software from HP and is now using it to make its devices "smart."  Platform is written in Javascript, Python is used for creating the automated tests.

positions.title: Mobile Application Engineer
positions.description: Worked on mobile application which interfaces to escalation support issues.  Provided way to locate a specific issue or see status for a specific customer.

positions.title: Interviewee for Software Automation Tester
positions.description: Automated manual test cases in Python.

positions.title: iOS Engineer
positions.description:
iOS Engineer
Worked in Point of Sale (POS) Group
Group creates iOS application used by salespersons in Apple Retail Stores
Projects
1. Consumer Law - Chinese market app enhancement so when customers request repair they can also elect to receive replaced part.  Required changes on intake and pick flows and logic plus integration with middle and back end systems.
2. Early Field Failure Analysis (EFFA)  Previous when Apple wanted to track returns of particular products they would issue bulletens to Apple Stores, employees had to read and understand them then would have to remember to fill out a form via a website.  All of that was integrated into the application.  From within existing return UI, serial number of product and other information was sent to the back end which would then deliver xml used by app to create screen flow to collect data within the existing return UI flow.

positions.title: Principal
positions.description:
Currently working as a Mobile Software Engineer. After having release my own applications on iPhone, Android, Palm and Nokia plaftorm I'm working to help other build their mobile presence using native technologies on iOS and Android as well as web technologies using Phonegap.

Specialties: Javascript/HTML/CSS, Android/Java, iOS/Objective-C

positions.title: Senior Consultant - Engineering
positions.description: Mobile Software Engineering working with client company Appcelerator.

positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description:
Company provides API for determining indoor location ( w/o using GPS)
* Built native iOS Objective C library, Cocoa, Xcode
* Built PhoneGap iPhone/Android clients and custom PhoneGap plugins
* Mobile Apps used jQuery Mobile, Google Maps and custom Javascript code

positions.title: Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
* 2 products in iPhone (iTunes) / Android / Palm (webOS) / Nokia (Ovi) application stores 
* 3 products on Symbian platform using Symbian C++ / Nokia S60
* Worked with Cocoa, Xcode, and Eclipse development environment.
* Company website written in jQuery / PHP / MySQL 
* Current product uses OO Javascript / HTML5 / CSS3, animation, and drag and drop

positions.title: White box QE Engineer
positions.description:
* Wrote white box JUnit test cases for Symbian Developer Website 
* Wrote Selenium Automated UI test cases 
* Wrote JMeter Automated performance test cases

positions.title: White box QA Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote white box test cases for Yahoo Advertising Engine
JUnit test cases for Java APIs
Selenium test case for Web UI

positions.title: Java White Box Test Engineer
positions.description: Writing white box tests in Java for Palm next generation OS.

positions.title: Java Web Application Engineer
positions.description: Wrote integration code between customer's payroll software and companies web services which held event information gathered from cell phones.

positions.title: Java Web Application Engineer
positions.description: Performed back-end AJAX parsing of Flash client information into Disney Corps. Java/J2EE system.

positions.title: Front-end Web Development Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead developer for enterprise web application software designed to help companies with regulatory compliance.

projects.title: Why W@it - mobile payment platform
projects.description: Mobile / Web based payment platform.  iOS / Android / web clients. Features pictures of items and ability to add more than one person to an order.
